title: Portainer addon catalog
description: Catalog of installable Portainer addons. Each entry carries the metadata management views and the app switcher need, plus the path and in-cluster service the /addons reverse-proxy gateway routes to.

id.description: Stable machine identifier for the addon, e.g. portal-template.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown to users and used for install.

shortDescription.description: One-line tagline shown in the app switcher, where space is tight. Keep it short; the full description is used in management views.

description.description: Full human-readable summary of what the addon does, shown in management views.

helmChartRepository.description: Helm chart repository the addon is installed from.

icon.description: Icon used in management views and the app switcher.

path.description: URL path the gateway routes to this addon, e.g. /addons/portal-template.

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the addon's in-cluster service, addressed as <service>.portainer-addon-<id>.svc.cluster.local — the Helm release always installs into the Portainer-owned portainer-addon-<id> namespace.

healthCheckPath.description: Path, appended to serviceUrl, that Portainer probes for the addon's health. Must be a dedicated readiness endpoint returning 2xx only when the addon is ready to serve (convention: /readyz), never a UI/catch-all route.
